description: Likely to cause disagreement or argument.
example: Remote work is still a contentious topic in many companies.

description: To move or grow faster than someone or something else.
translation: Superar en ritmo, crecer más rápido que.
example: Demand for developers has outpaced the number of graduates.

description: A person or company competing with another for the same thing.
example: Their main rival launched a similar product last month.

description: An economy based on skills, information and ideas rather than manufacturing.
example: In a knowledge economy, continuous learning matters more than seniority.

description: The management of money, or the money available to a person or company.
example: I'm trying to get my personal finances in order this year.

description: Without being affected by something; anyway.
example: I'll apply for the job regardless of the salary they offer.

description: To separate one group of people or things from another.
example: The policy segregated workers by department instead of by project.
